0.name: UNRESUMED
0.drop_behavior: Jump to drop_clean block (drops captured upvars only)

1.name: RETURNED
1.resume_behavior: Async/Coroutine: Assert(false, ResumedAfterReturn); Gen: return Option::None; AsyncGen: return Poll::Ready(None)
1.drop_behavior: Fall through to default_block (immediate Return; all locals already dropped)

2.name: POISONED
2.resume_behavior: Assert(false, ResumedAfterPanic) when can_unwind is true; omitted when panic=abort or !can_unwind
2.drop_behavior: Fall through to default_block (immediate Return; unwind cleanup already dropped live fields)

3..3+K.name: Suspend0..Suspend(K-1)
3..3+K.resume_behavior: Emit StorageLive for non-remapped storage-live locals, move resume_arg, Goto(point.resume)
3..3+K.drop_behavior: Emit StorageLive for non-remapped storage-live locals, Goto(point.drop) ladder ending at CoroutineDrop -> Return

coroutine_kinds.movability: Movable (implements Unpin when upvars/locals are Unpin)
coroutine_kinds.tree_borrows_retag_on_self: StrongProtector + ReservedFrz (no self-referential borrows permitted across yield in movable gen)

coroutine_kinds.movability: Static (!Unpin) or Movable (Unpin if fields are Unpin)
coroutine_kinds.tree_borrows_retag_on_self: NOP when Static (!Unpin); StrongProtector + ReservedFrz when Movable (Unpin)
